title: sebastiania hispida var. subglabrata
intro:
Sebastiania hispida var. subglabrata, commonly known as "Candiru", is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Sebastiania hispida var. subglabrata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and safety for medicinal use.

Note: Please consult with a healthcare professional before using any plant for medicinal purposes.
